Shares, the paid-up Eq. share capital of the Co. stands increased from Rs.49.25 crs to Rs.52.14 crs consisting of 260723629 Eq. Shares. *The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change vide Nt. dt 21.7.22, notified Regulations on Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) for waste tyre. Under the said Regulations, the Co. is required to meet specified waste recycling targets (levy) from the FY ended 31.3.23 onwards. The obligations are to be fulfilled by purchasing certificates from the recyclers who are registered with the CPCB. The Calculation of the levy is based on the domestic revenue, generated in FY 20-21 (used for computing obligation in FY 22-23) and in FY 21-22 (used for computing obligation in FY 23-24). Consequently, the Co. is required to recognize a liability with respect to the levy as at the end of the current FY. Due to lack of necessary mechanism/ infrastructure for the fulfilment of aforesaid obligation in the earlier year, the Co. has recognized the provision for the FY ended 31.3.23, amounting to Rs.32.30 crs in the year ended 31.3. 24 (which has been disclosed as an exceptional item).The provision taken for FY 23-24 is Rs.73.33 crs (which has been disclosed as part of other expenses).*Exceptional items also include favourable foreign exchange fluctuation of Rs.8.78 crs & Rs.10.11 crs and VRS Expense of Rs.0.94 cr & Rs.5.16 crs for the qtr and year ended 31.3.24 respectively.*The figures of current and corresponding qtr are the balancing figures between audited figures in respect of the full FY and the published year to date figures upto the 3rdqtr of the current/corresponding FY. *The above results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board at their respective meetings held on 21.5.24.The auditors have carried out the audit of the same. *Figures for the previous periods have been regrouped/rearranged, wherever necessary In view of space constraints while filing results, the note regarding Competition Commission of India and the ongoing case pertaining thereto is not reproduced here for which PDF file may be referred.
